'''María del Carmen Clapp Jiménez Labora'''<ref name="dgcs"/> (born 13 December 1955) is a Mexican endocrinologist. She is a professor emerita at [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] and a 1994 [[Guggenheim Fellow]].

==Biography==
Clapp was born on 13 December 1955 in [[Mexico City]].<ref name="GF"/> She obtained a BS in Biology from the [[Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana]] in 1978, before obtaining an MS in 1983 and PhD in 1984 - both in physiology - from the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] (UNAM).<ref name="GF"/><ref name="unam">{{Cite web |title=Carmen Clapp |url=http://personal.inb.unam.mx/clapp/ |access-date=2026-07-19 |website=UNAM Institute of Neurobiology |archive-date=19 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260719205912/http://personal.inb.unam.mx/clapp/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

In 1984, Clapp became a research associate professor C at UNAM.<ref name="GF"/> She was promoted to research professor A in 1988, before becoming a research professor B at the {{ill|UNAM Institute of Neurobiology|es|Instituto de Neurobiología (UNAM)}} (INB) in 1994.<ref name="GF"/> In 1993, she was a visiting scholar at INSERM U-344 at [[Necker–Enfants Malades Hospital]].<ref name="GF"/> She was also a postdoctoral fellow at the [[University of California at Berkeley]] from 1985 to 1988, as well as a [[Rockefeller Foundation]] fellow at [[University of California, San Francisco]] from 1989 to 1994.<ref name="GF"/> In 2022, she was promoted to professor emerita at UNAM.<ref name="unam"/> She has also served as the INB's head of the Department of Cellular and Molecular Neurobiology at the INB.<ref name="Gaceta 2016"/>

As a scientist, Clapp studies endocrinology, particularly as it relates to [[vasoinhibin]]s.<ref name="Gaceta 2016">{{cite magazine |date=2016-11-07 |title=Estudio de la participación hormonal en la fisiopatología de enfermedades de la angiogénesis |url=http://www.gaceta.unam.mx/20161107/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/suplementopun.pdf |magazine=Gaceta UNAM |pages=5–6 |access-date=19 July 2026 |archive-date=18 November 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161118101732/http://www.gaceta.unam.mx/20161107/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/suplementopun.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1994,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Carmen Clapp |url=https://www.gf.org/fellows/carmen-clapp |access-date=2026-07-19 |website=Guggenheim Fellowships |archive-date=19 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260719211919/https://www.gf.org/fellows/carmen-clapp |url-status=live }}</ref> she was awarded a [[Guggenheim Fellowship]] "for a study of the endogenous nature of 16K [[prolactin]] as a potential inhibitor of [[angiogenesis]] and tumor growth".<ref name="GF"/> [[Roche]] México awarded her research project a 2006 Jorge Rosenkranz Medical Research
